why: An object's NameID (+0x28) is its enemy id: BN5's CanGard family is 0x4F-0x54, moved as BN6's ids 0x200-0x205, and its Handi family 0x13-0x18 as 0x206-0x20B, the families' (src/emu/xvirus_families.c, .first_id; xvirus_recipe.h, XV_FIRST_ID); BN5's Navis by their recipes (src/emu/xnavi_bn5.c, .first_id; src/emu/xnavi_recipe.h, XN_ID_OF): ToadMan's V1-SP 0x143-0x146 as 0x1D8-0x1DB, KnightMan's 0x13D-0x140 as 0x1D4-0x1D7, ShadowMan's 0x12B-0x12E as 0x1C8-0x1CB, NumberMan's 0x131-0x134 as 0x1CC-0x1CF, TomahawkMan's 0x137-0x13A as 0x1D0-0x1D3, Colonel's 0x125-0x128 as 0x1C4-0x1C7, the Dark Soul's 0x18D as 0x1DC, the Darkloids ShadeMan's 0x149-0x14C as 0x1E0-0x1E3 and BlizzardMan's 0x14F-0x152 as 0x1E4-0x1E7, CosmoMan's 0x15B-0x15E as 0x1EC-0x1EF and CloudMan's 0x155-0x158 as 0x1E8-0x1EB, Nebula's LarkMan's 0x161-0x164 as 0x3EC-0x3EF and GridMan's 0x167-0x16A as 0x3F0-0x3F3, Team ProtoMan's NapalmMan's 0x113-0x116 as 0x1FC-0x1FF GyroMan's 0x107-0x10A as 0x1F4-0x1F7, SearchMan's 0x10D-0x110 as 0x1F8-0x1FB, Meddy's 0x11F-0x122 as 0x3E8-0x3EB and MagnetMan's 0x119-0x11C as 0x3E4-0x3E7; MegaMan is 0x180 in BN5 and 0x1A0 in BN6 (his battle object's NameID in both traces from their first frame).

megaman_forms.why: MegaMan's NameID in a form of BN6's is 0x1AB + the form (0x08015B22 writes it as he crosses: 0x1AC-0x1C3; 0x1A0 in none), where BN5's stays 0x180 through a Soul and its end (the research's runs/nid). His role is MegaMan's whatever his form; his NameID is compared as BN6 writes it for the form BN5's maps to (a Soul behind the proxy, 0x1B3).
